title: Robustly acyclic orientations and cover graphs

problemStatement.formal: Relate rank-based robustly acyclic orientations to cover graphs, with empty/bipartite constructions and `cover_graph_characterization` as the main remaining axiom.
problemStatement.plain: Which graphs admit robustly acyclic orientations, and how does that connect to cover graphs of finite posets?
whyMatters: This is the parent scaffold for the Erdos #1006 cover-graph subquestions.

proven: Bipartite graphs admit robust orientations under the rank-based setup.
Cover graphs admit robust orientations when the poset/rank hypotheses are available.
open: `cover_graph_characterization` remains an axiom for the full iff statement.
The high-girth counterexample and FFLLW bridge are still represented axiomatically in this parent scaffold.
